insights.name: Creation mix — durable new entities
insights.description: 30-day durable creation records, deduplicated by random record ID. Imports/restores excluded. Task subtype not_applicable; cut_down separate from amount. Opt-in iPhone production installations only; counts describe creations, not current inventory.
insights.query: SELECT properties.entity_type AS entity_type, properties.habit_type AS habit_type, uniq(properties.analytics_record_id) AS creations, uniq(distinct_id) AS creators FROM events WHERE event = 'entity_created' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY entity_type, habit_type ORDER BY creations DESC

insights.name: Active days & accepted tracking — UTC collection periods
insights.description: Feature summaries deduplicated before summing durable writes. Active includes foreground or accepted external actions. Daily UTC collection date; late delivery may arrive up to seven days later. Installation counts are observed sample counts, never exact people.
insights.query: SELECT period, uniq(distinct_id) AS consenting_active_installations, sum(writes) AS accepted_tracking_writes FROM (SELECT properties.analytics_record_id AS record, distinct_id, any(toDateTime(toInt(properties.period_start_utc))) AS period, any(toInt(properties.tracking_write_count)) AS writes FROM events WHERE event = 'feature_usage_daily' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY record, distinct_id) GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

insights.name: Feature adoption — observed installation cohort
insights.description: Each row: positive flag/counter installations divided by installations with a daily feature envelope. Progress/chart capabilities exist on this iPhone client. Missing/unobserved adapter coverage is not feature disuse. Operations are separate from adoption.

insights.name: First observed tracking — known cohort only
insights.description: First accepted write after consent, not necessarily lifetime first write. Existing/restored provenance is currently unknown; this is not a fresh-install onboarding funnel. Pre-consent activity is intentionally missing. Never join installation ID to an account.
insights.query: SELECT properties.cohort AS cohort, properties.habit_type AS habit_type, uniq(distinct_id) AS installations FROM events WHERE event = 'activation_reached' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY cohort, habit_type

insights.name: Observed installation return days — no person retention
insights.description: Distribution of covered active UTC days within rolling 30 days. Foreground or accepted external action days. This describes consenting sampled installations, not unique people, lifetime retention, or cross-device users; missing delivery can undercount returns.
insights.query: SELECT observed_active_days, count() AS installations FROM (SELECT distinct_id, uniq(period) AS observed_active_days FROM (SELECT distinct_id, properties.analytics_record_id AS record, any(toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS period, any(toInt(properties.tracking_write_count)) AS tracking_write_count FROM events WHERE event = 'feature_usage_daily' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY distinct_id, record) GROUP BY distinct_id) GROUP BY observed_active_days ORDER BY observed_active_days

insights.name: Local backup & durable restore outcomes
insights.description: Success = local file generated or durable merge completed. File sharing does not prove external storage or cloud backup exists. Controlled failure codes only; no file names, paths, content, counts or raw errors. Importer cancellation recorded separately.
insights.query: SELECT properties.operation AS operation, properties.provider AS provider, properties.result AS result, properties.failure_code AS failure_code, uniq(properties.analytics_record_id) AS completed_flows FROM events WHERE event = 'backup_restore_result' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY operation, provider, result, failure_code

insights.name: Latest account / backup / capability state
insights.description: Latest snapshot per consenting installation in collection period. Baseline no_account/local_only automatic; device backup existence unknown. Unsupported account/sync/widgets/onboarding/purchase reported false, never measured as zero adoption. State is observed, not server truth.
insights.query: SELECT account_state, primary, primary_source, secondary, backup_status, widgets_available, purchase_available, count() AS installations FROM (SELECT distinct_id, argMax(properties.account_state, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS account_state, argMax(properties.backup_primary, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS primary, argMax(properties.primary_source, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS primary_source, argMax(properties.secondary_copy, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS secondary, argMax(properties.effective_backup_status, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS backup_status, argMax(properties.capability_widgets, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS widgets_available, argMax(properties.capability_purchase, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS purchase_available FROM events WHERE event = 'configuration_snapshot' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY distinct_id) GROUP BY account_state, primary, primary_source, secondary, backup_status, widgets_available, purchase_available

insights.name: Storage queue / backup reliability — matching denominators
insights.description: Summed controlled successful/failed queue operations, not SQL rows or crash sessions. Daily record IDs deduplicated. Backup denominator is observed file generation/restore. Incidents/recovery bounded; no crash-free claims, raw errors, stack traces or polling events.
insights.query: SELECT sum(storage_success_count) AS storage_success, sum(storage_failure_count) AS storage_failed, storage_failed / nullIf(storage_success + storage_failed, 0) AS storage_failure_fraction, sum(backup_success_count) AS backup_success, sum(backup_failure_count) AS backup_failed FROM (SELECT distinct_id, properties.analytics_record_id AS record, any(toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS period, any(toInt(properties.storage_success_count)) AS storage_success_count, any(toInt(properties.storage_failure_count)) AS storage_failure_count, any(toInt(properties.backup_success_count)) AS backup_success_count, any(toInt(properties.backup_failure_count)) AS backup_failure_count FROM events WHERE event = 'feature_usage_daily' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY distinct_id, record)

insights.name: Coverage / sampling / delivery-loss warnings
insights.description: Observed sample/version, partial consent days and incomplete coverage. delivery_loss_count is cumulative per installation; latest per installation prevents repeated loss overcounting. Queue/retention/cap losses mean missing data. No envelopes means unknown coverage.
insights.query: SELECT sample_rate, sampling_version, complete, partial, count() AS installations, sum(loss) AS latest_reported_loss FROM (SELECT distinct_id, argMax(properties.sample_rate, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS sample_rate, argMax(properties.sampling_version, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS sampling_version, argMax(properties.coverage_complete, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS complete, argMax(properties.collection_started_mid_period, toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS partial, argMax(toInt(properties.delivery_loss_count), toInt(properties.period_start_utc)) AS loss FROM events WHERE event = 'feature_usage_daily' AND properties.release_channel = 'production' AND properties.schema_version = 1 AND properties.platform = 'ios' AND properties.analytics_record_id IS NOT NULL AND toInt(properties.period_start_utc) >= toUnixTimestamp(now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY distinct_id) GROUP BY sample_rate, sampling_version, complete, partial

insights.name: Monthly project ingestion — budget watch
insights.description: Raw project received events this UTC month, including retry duplicates and any other emitter. 700k planning ceiling; published free analytics allowance 1M/month. This is not authoritative organization billing usage; billing:read unavailable. Owner confirms no billing configured.
insights.query: SELECT count() AS received_project_events, uniq(properties.analytics_record_id) AS distinct_contract_records, 700000 AS app_planning_ceiling, 1000000 AS published_free_allowance FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now())
